استوجبن (form X)
# اِسْتَوْجَبْنَ (istawjabna) /is.taw.d͡ʒab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
# اُسْتُوجِبْنَ (ustūjibna) /us.tuː.d͡ʒib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
# اِسْتَوْجِبْنَ (istawjibna) /is.taw.d͡ʒib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
